notes.title: The Wait is Over: Play B.ARK Now!
notes.content:
Buy now during launch week for 20% off!
 Own this exciting shoot ‘em up adventure for only $7.99!
 Single-player and 4-player Co-op!
 Steam Remote Play!
 Difficulty Modes for players new to shmups and veterans of the genre!


Blast off into the far reaches of the Solar System with the four fur-ocious members of Team B.ARK! This Saturday-morning cartoon inspired shoot ‘em up sees pets in mechs fight the good fight against the evil cybernetic fish armada known as the Dark Tide. Can you and your squad defeat their tyrannical leader, Chog, before his deep-sea forces completely take over the Solar System?!

[previewyoutube=N-LJ88gO0es;full][/previewyoutube]

Meet Our Heroes
It’s up to Barker the Dog, Felicity the Cat, Marv the Rabbit, and Lucio the Bear to stop the Dark Tide from spreading their reign of terror into outer space! Each member of Team B.ARK has their own unlockable backstory that explains their unique gameplay. Whether they bring out the big guns to savagely blast through the enemy, or they focus on shielding the team from chaotic Dark Tide firepower, these animals all have one thing in common—they’re fighting to save their home planet, Earth!

Fight Alongside Friends!
Recruit up to 4 players in co-op as you battle through multiple stages full of stunning hand-animated enemies and bosses. Fuse your Supers with teammates and unleash out-of-this-world Super Combinations capable of completely vanquishing waves of incoming enemy forces! Work as a team, but be sure to grab the most Plutonium from defeated enemies to see how your high-score stacks against your fellow teammates.

Defeat the Big Baddies
Battle Chog’s challenging generals as you go up against bosses like Spike the Narwhal and Vic the Sea Snake, who are dead set on destroying Team B.ARK at all costs. It’s going to take courage and skill to evade and defeat these villains’ unique attack patterns.

Don’t Believe the Dark Tide
Chog and his minions now own the news! Be wary of newscasters like Gil Flounders, who are paid a mighty sum to spread misinformation about surface-dwellers like Team B.ARK. Our heroes are hard at work pushing back against endless waves of Dark Tide forces. It’s time to squad up and fight to take back the Earth in B.ARK!

notes.title: Papa Bear Thinks Chog’s Tyranny is a Load of Carp
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/276147b0a0c77c4280d4c287b06b3d19ebeaa7c8.png

Meet Lucio
Lucio the Bear hails from a quiet little Italian town, but the time for hibernation is over. He believes it’s important to know the facts about Team B.ARK so you don't fall for the Dark Tide’s propaganda videos hook, line, and sinker.

[previewyoutube=fjazK9PulXg;full][/previewyoutube]

How He Plays
Come to the rescue of injured comrades with Lucio’s helpful shield ship, Mossy Pig II. Protect the entire crew with Mossy Pig II’s super attack, Bear Hug, which grows in size with each fusion to envelope multiple teammates in his shield’s safe embrace.

Backstory
Adopted as a cub by the kind-hearted Ricci family, they accepted Lucio as one of their own by teaching him the family fishing business. He loved spending his afternoons out at sea with the family, sharing one whale-of-a-tale after another before returning home to his favorite dish: a hot plate of freshly baked pizza. When a tragic attack from the invading Dark Tide overturned all the fishing vessels and flooded his village, he joined B.ARK to help stop the ensuing violence and restore peace among the planets. Lucio is stepping up and taking the lead with Team B.ARK to bring justice to all friends and family lost at sea.

notes.title: It’s Dark Tide Season for This Rabbit
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/e3b0faa9995d6136f9cd0c728dc8410bff27c5d7.png

Meet Marv
Marv the Rabbit usually spends his days frolicking with his 37 siblings, but the annual family high-jump competition has been indefinitely postponed. Gill Flounder’s latest propaganda broadcast claims Marv is a pink speed demon. . . and he’s absolutely right! Be afraid. Be very afraid (no...not you, Marv.)

[previewyoutube=KMz5f6IOaA4;full][/previewyoutube]

How He Plays
His ship, Lucky 7, is the quickest of the bunch and comes equipped with inescapable homing missiles. Put a big bullseye on Chog’s Army with Lucky 7’s super attack, Fearful Focus, which slows down all enemies on screen.

Backstory
As the smallest member of Team B.ARK, Marv is no stranger to needing pep in his step to survive. In his Nevada desert hometown, he was often prey to the wildlife and spent most of his time in his family’s cozy desert burrows. When the invading Dark Tide eventually found its way deep underground in the form of terrifying drilling bots, Marv’s fleeing family was separated in the chaos. In a desperate attempt to escape the uprooting of his home, Marv dug faster than he’d ever dug before... and landed inside a secret B.ARK facility! With his family’s continued survival on the line, Marv joined the B.ARK Team to go from scaredy cat (sorry Felicity!) to rabbit champ. Hop through enemy fire with the quick reflexes of this anxious little rabbit and show the Dark Tide size doesn’t matter when your family’s on the line.

notes.title: Chog Beware: This Kitty Bites!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/2898ba45d217d1c03209937bb3b4b7600f09e177.png

Meet Felicity
Felicity the Cat is here to chew some catnip and trash enemy robots, and she’s all out of catnip. Have you seen the latest Dark Tide propaganda video? Gill Flounders is right about one thing: Chog’s Army should fear “Machine Gun” Felicity and her devastating drive for victory!

[previewyoutube=zEVjOA-5p0I;full][/previewyoutube]

How She Plays
Her ship, Payback, is equipped with a powerful spread shot. Destroy all in your path with Payback’s super attack, Cat’s Gaze, which maximizes firepower into multiple rows of devastating bullets. Completing her mission means never having to say, “I’m out of ammo.” 

Backstory
As a former stray cat with no familial connections, Felicity has spent her life fending for herself on the mean streets of Paris. Despite her habit of running solo, she joined the B.ARK Team as an opportunity to fight for more than just the Solar System—she’s bent on settling an old score! Betrayed by her best friend, Bubbles the Goldfish, Felicity clings to the promise of finding him and finally enacting revenge. Taking down Chog comes second to using Bubbles’ mech as her scratching post. This wise-cracking kitty is ready to charge right into the thick of things, tear through her enemies, and hopefully be back before naptime.

notes.title: Dark Tide is No Match for This Good Boy
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/ceea580245a989305eaa4885460f602404859a6e.png

Meet Barker
Barker the Dog may be small and drooly, but he’s off his leash and ready to help the B.ARK Team blast their way to victory. Don’t fall for the Dark Tide’s malicious propaganda video! Peanut butter may be Barker’s weakness, but that’s only because he tends to eat so much it gives him a belly ache.

[previewyoutube=-ReEKyAKXBY;full][/previewyoutube]

How He plays
His sturdy ship, Wishbone, has extra firepower from up to three tiny helpers. Take out entire waves of foes with Wishbone’s super attack, Bullet Stream, which launches huge projectiles at an increased fire rate.

Backstory
Having grown up with his kind and caring owner Milla, Barker has known nothing but belly rubs and long games of fetch. After Milla is taken prisoner by the invading Dark Tide, this powerful pup’s love for her fuels him with the determination needed to take on anything the enemy throws his way. Together with the rest of the team, Barker is ready to show Chog’s Army his bark is just as fierce as his bite.

notes.title: Bringing the Characters of B.ARK to Life
notes.content:
At Tic Toc Games, we put together our love for SHMUPS and traditionally animated TV shows together to create our multiplayer co-op shooter, B.ARK. The look of the game went through quite an evolution from when we first showed it to today.  Here is the story of how our art process and the game’s look got developed.

Friendly Fire
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/83330297a781231cb6ca345a0335c0b4f99679da.png
Original Gameplay Demo

The core concept behind B.ARK was to make a SHMUP that was accessible to all age groups while still maintaining the challenge for more hardcore gamers. To achieve that, we wanted to make a game that was very co-op friendly where a stronger player can help carry a more novice player through the game.

We made a 4 player prototype, and our test audiences really enjoyed it! We then had to think about where to take the narrative and look of these characters, and how we were going to bring them to life!

Character Design
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/b713ee70c788c47379956f23cad28c2149284c73.png
High Concept Sketches of Main Characters

Many iterations of the characters were made while thinking about the type of abilities each one has and how that gets reflected in their look. We wanted the cat to be small but aggressive, the dog to be friendly, the bear to be strong and defensive, and the rabbit to be quick.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/dc1ac9e64ce7aa3a500ea6de84e9f29012669fcc.png
We settled on looks that best represented their abilities as well as their personalities.

For the final design of the ships, we decided to go with yellow for Lucio the bear to show that he’s strong and fortified, but a lot of round edges to also show he’s still cuddly. Barker the dog, we went with blue as he’s the friendliest, but gave him a few angles, so he’s not just a softy. Felicity the cat retains some sharp features, but also stays compact, and Marv the rabbit is very much a big triangle showing that he’s all about speed.

During this time we also did a few passes on the pilots. Making sure their personalities match their abilities and the backstories that we were giving to them.

Turnaround
Once we finalized our design, it was time to prep it for animation! Animators were provided with turnaround sheets of each character so they have a good idea of what details they need to know about from all angles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/e5a0d5487288f2c81958f7fa825bc14a051059e5.png
Turnaround sheet for Barker

Expression Sheet
Along with turnarounds for the characters and their mech ships, we also created expression sheets for the 4 main characters and some of the non playable characters. These were useful for several areas including dialogue box portraits, cinematics, and player heads up displays.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/3791e3a05da7e2baab0785b518c80c675ba712eb.jpg
Expression sheet for all of Marv’s emotions

Thumbnails
Now it’s time to animate! Animators usually start will small thumbnail drawings to map out the animation sequence that they are going to work on. This helps them prep, but also helps us review and make sure the sequence works for the gameplay in mind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/8144db8fceadbf8ebfccd84817f0bf5f3c6e81fc.png
Thumbnail designs for Lucio’s end of level victory pose

Keyframes and Timing Charts
Once thumbnails are approved, the full scale animations are started with animators drawing keyframes. These are the important poses that define the action and provide enough information to be sent to other animators to inbetween the motions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/5c8c1f8af6dde97d5eb8f7219b8c78afbd7287fc.png
Keyframe of Felicity’s victory animation with guidelines and timing charts

To further help the inbetweeners, the keyframe animators will provide timing charts that show how many frames will need to be added between each key, and how to space out those frames to ease in and out of motions.

Inbetweens
After keyframes are completed, they are sent to inbetweeners to fill in the animations between the keyframes. This helps smooth out the animation and bring it to life! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/f293483bf4dcd3fb76cd6f3bc69bde2383bfd107.gif
Barker’s idle animation fully inbetweened with shadow lines as well

Final Color
With approvals on inbetweens, all that’s left is cleaning up and coloring, and that’s one animation done! Below you can see the whole sequence coming to life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38724938/f6b87822e6cf1d94f91a646f54458e4a43cdc8ed.gif
The full process of Felicity’s Super Attack from beginning to end

Now you just have to take that and multiply the process with all characters, enemies, and bosses!  Whew! Thanks for reading! Hope this provides you with more appreciation for animation and the time it takes to make this beautiful art form!
